title: psychotria capensis subsp. riparia
intro: Psychotria capensis subsp. riparia, commonly known as Cape Upland Cranberry, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, and act as a natural diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Cape Upland Cranberry include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
